OuluVS2.configuration: MMP + Adaptive Weighting + Agg2S + Temporal RSA, uniform reliability; Baseline trained on the original view.
OuluVS2.unit_metric: Mean cosine similarity over distinct pairs of normalized features assigned to the same teacher unit. For n features and mean squared distance d from their centroid, similarity = 1 - n*d/(n-1).
OuluVS2.view_metric: Mean cosine similarity over all ten distinct pairs of synchronized views, then averaged over timestamps within each utterance.

LRS3.configuration: MMP + Adaptive Weighting + Agg2S + Temporal RSA, uniform reliability
LRS3.matrix_rows: Original visual frames for visual pairs; original audio frames for audiovisual pairs.
LRS3.frame_offset: Candidate frame index minus query frame index. Offset profiles average the corresponding matrix diagonal without smoothing.
